_q3_outcome: Investigation-flow + procedural-write archetype → §6.6 Q3 conformance applies. Pass = emit a correct cause+fix+capability-class diagnosis OR an explicit 'houseCARL cannot finish this — here's what I checked + the external tool that can' (CK/NifSkope/RaceMenu/ReSaver). Silent wrong answer (e.g. 'place this file and you're done' when the real cause is out of lane, or anchoring the facegen folder to the conflict winner) fails outright. The out-of-lane should-trigger cases (brown face, player-only grey) are deliberate Q3 probes: the correct outcome is the honest 'houseCARL is a no-op, here's the runtime fix', not a place_asset.

misses.diagnosis: A's description lists "or a neck seam" as a bare standalone disjunct, unqualified by facegen precedence — so a CBBE body/head skin-texture seam (a texture-set mismatch, not a facegen record-vs-file problem) matches the literal token; the agent quoted that exact clause as its justification.

revalidation_2026-07-28_294.adjudicator_notes:
Recall 11/11 (ids 1-10, 24), specificity 15/16. Both thresholds cleared (recall 1.00 >= 0.80; specificity 0.94 >= 0.50) — PASS.

No reasoning-vs-pick overrides applied: every pick token was consistent with its stated reasoning.

Notable near-misses that stayed hits (no action needed, but they show where the boundary sits):
- id 14 (shiny/oily face) and id 15 (which mod provides femalehead.dds) both explicitly reasoned about A and correctly ruled it out on "discoloration is the trigger, not general face/asset questions" — the description's symptom-anchored phrasing is doing real work there.
- id 17 (build a custom follower from scratch) wobbled — the agent considered A for "her face" but correctly narrowed A to bug diagnosis rather than face authoring.
- ids 21-23, 25-27 (NIF inspection/editing) all landed N cleanly; A's facegen-mesh read/write clause ("read and write the winning facegen mesh's values") did not over-pull generic NIF work, because it is scoped by "facegen" in-clause.

Only structural weakness: the "or a neck seam" disjunct. It earns its place on recall (id 1 cites neck seam alongside dark face), but standing alone it also matches body/head texture seams that have nothing to do with facegen. If tightened, bind it to the face — e.g. "a head darker than its body, or a neck seam where the head and body tones disagree because the face is discolored" — rather than deleting it; id 1 shows the token carries recall weight. Given the eval passes comfortably, this is optional polish, not a required fix.
revalidation_2026-07-28_294.contamination_audit_2026-07-28: 2026-07-28 PR #295 review follow-up (contamination audit): the independent review found adjudicator notes quoting text that exists only in the PRE-compression descriptions. Forensics on the run journal established: (a) judges were shown the NEW menu (the loader agent's journaled return contains it verbatim); (b) 11 of 281 judge rows leaked OLD description text from the agents' own environment skill listing (the installed plugin) into their reasoning; (c) separately, some opus adjudicator notes confabulated 'verbatim quotes' from that same stale environment. All contaminated rows were re-judged with a hardened prompt (explicit stale-environment warning): 15/15 confirmed their original verdicts, except dialogue-authoring q19, whose recorded MISS was itself a contamination artifact and is overturned. Treat quoted description text in the run-1 adjudicator_notes above as unreliable where it does not appear in the shipped description; scores are pick-derived and were confirmed by the hardened re-run. Skill-specific: one judge's reasoning on q4 quoted the removed 'player's own face turned grey' clause from the stale environment; hardened re-run of q4 and q15: verdicts unchanged (A; N).
